description: This file contains Makefile snippets for building root filesystem packages, including conditional macros for handling libraries, package managers, and configuration scripts.

methods.name: mklibs
methods.description: A macro to create minimized libraries and programs by finding executables and shared objects, and then processing them to produce stripped down versions.

methods.name: opkg
methods.description: A macro for configuring the opkg package manager with specific options for installation root and other parameters.

methods.name: apk
methods.description: A macro for configuring the apk package manager with specific options for installation root and security keys.

methods.name: clean_ipkg
methods.description: A macro for cleaning up package manager state, removing certain files and fixing status files.

methods.name: prepare_rootfs
methods.description: A macro to prepare the root filesystem for deployment, including copying files, running post-install scripts, enabling/disabling services, cleaning up version control directories, and stripping libraries.
